purpose: Reusable VERIFY/QA block for existing packets/work graph. Produce executable evidence/disposition while keeping candidate visibility, CURRENT and promotion authority in their existing owners.

invocation.assignable_to: any compatible /wc shell through existing portfolio/PIN allocation

selector_law: Select the cheapest depth that satisfies explicit acceptance vectors and risk floor. Browser/visual/E2E depth is never added merely because the artifact is UI when deterministic evidence is sufficient.

candidate_visibility.restriction: Existing safety/acceptance policy may still gate visibility. QA_PENDING never means promoted/current.

disposition.PASS_HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Emit READY_TO_PROMOTE plus evidence; existing acceptance owner decides after explicit human approval.
disposition.PASS_AUTO_PROMOTABLE: Emit QA_PASS plus promotion-ready signal to existing promotion authority; QA does not promote directly.
disposition.FAIL: Emit QA_REPAIR_IN_PROGRESS and a bounded repair successor descriptor for GUIDE_INTEGRATOR/semantic successor machinery, then require reverify.
disposition.BOUNDARY: Emit QA_BLOCKED with exact capability/authority/transport boundary; never manufacture PASS.
disposition.PENDING: Emit QA_PENDING; candidate may remain visible when existing policy allows.

repair_reuse.rule: Material repair successor uses existing semantic successor PIN and normal portfolio execution PIN; repaired version must be reverified against the same still-applicable acceptance vectors.

promotion_reuse.rule: QA can make promotion readiness observable but cannot mutate CURRENT or bypass human approval where existing policy requires it.

requirements: stable unversioned mutable asset is a failure
served_asset_canary.browser_truth_boundary: Deterministic served/staging evidence is not representative interaction evidence. A browser PASS requires an actual browser-capable verifier.

precompile_downstream.restriction: Precompilation creates no execution or promotion authority.

primary_chat_projection.rule: Surface a compact QA state only when a durable mirrored result already carries one of the allowed statuses. Do not infer QA from prose or liveness.

required_harness_cases: human approval required -> READY_TO_PROMOTE not auto-promote
